description: This file defines decomposition functions for PyTorch's JIT compiler, including registration and signature matching for tensor operations, specifically for variance calculations.

methods.name: check_decomposition_has_type_annotations
methods.description: Checks that a function has proper type annotations for parameters and return value.

methods.name: signatures_match
methods.description: Compares two function signatures to determine if they match.

methods.name: register_decomposition
methods.description: Decorator to register a function as a decomposition for a specific torch operation.

methods.name: var_decomposition
methods.description: Performs variance decomposition on a tensor, with optional dimensions and correction.

methods.name: var
methods.description: Wrapper for variance decomposition with unbiased correction option.
